### Avoid quadratic complexity when coalescing text nodes in html in golang.org/x/net
[CVE-2026-78661](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-78661) / [GO-2026-6860](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6860)

<details>
<summary>More information</summary>

#### Details
When coalescing adjacent text nodes in addText and fosterParent, appending to an existing TextNode's Data via string concatenation (n.Data += text) reallocated and copied the accumulated string on every token. Inputs containing many short text runs separated by ignored end tags (such as "a</x>") caused O(n^2) allocations and byte copies.

Accumulate coalesced text in per-node byte slices during parsing and materialize Data strings once at the end of parse.

#### Severity
Unknown

#### References
- [https://go.dev/cl/849365](https://go.dev/cl/849365)
- [https://go.dev/issue/82224](https://go.dev/issue/82224)
- [https://groups.google.com/g/golang-announce/c/sqrs2vTx_Xs](https://groups.google.com/g/golang-announce/c/sqrs2vTx_Xs)

This data is provided by [OSV](https://osv.dev/vulnerability/GO-2026-6860) and the [Go Vulnerability Database](https://redirect.github.com/golang/vulndb) ([CC-BY 4.0](https://redirect.github.com/golang/vulndb#license)).
</details>

---

### Check all ancestor namespace transitions when rendering raw text in html in golang.org/x/net
[CVE-2026-97045](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-97045) / [GO-2026-6866](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6866)

<details>
<summary>More information</summary>

#### Details
In childTextNodesAreLiteral, walking up the tree previously stopped at the nearest foreign ancestor once an HTML integration point was found. However, that integration point may itself be a descendant of an element that was foster-parented into a foreign namespace (such as <mglyph> or <malignmark> fostered under <mtext>), causing a parser to resolve the subtree in a different foreign namespace upon re-parsing the rendered output.

Continue walking the full ancestor chain and verify that every transition from a non-empty namespace occurs at an HTML integration point before emitting literal text.

#### Severity
Unknown

#### References
- [https://go.dev/cl/855121](https://go.dev/cl/855121)
- [https://go.dev/issue/82622](https://go.dev/issue/82622)
- [https://groups.google.com/g/golang-announce/c/sqrs2vTx_Xs](https://groups.google.com/g/golang-announce/c/sqrs2vTx_Xs)

This data is provided by [OSV](https://osv.dev/vulnerability/GO-2026-6866) and the [Go Vulnerability Database](https://redirect.github.com/golang/vulndb) ([CC-BY 4.0](https://redirect.github.com/golang/vulndb#license)).
</details>
